title: Cosmological perturbation theory of primordial compact sources
summary: We construct a position-space cosmological perturbation theory around spatially flat Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker geometries that allows to model localized primordial sources of gravitational waves. The equations of motion are decoupled using a generalized harmonic gauge, which avoids the use of a scalar-vector-tensor decomposition. We point out that sources cannot generically be defined in a compact domain due to fluctuations of the cosmic perfect fluid.
